uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

uml-pg-tool-status.text: Drop on the canvas to place a Component. Esc to cancel.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "Component — Component":
  - heading "Component — Component" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Identifier
  - textbox "Identifier": Component
  - text: Stereotype (e.g. <<choice>>)
  - textbox "Stereotype (e.g. <<choice>>)"
  - checkbox "Dashed outline"
  - text: Dashed outline Highlight color (#hex or name)
  - textbox "Highlight color (#hex or name)"
  - text: Texture
  - combobox "Texture":
    - option "None" [selected]
    - option "Hatched"
    - option "Crosshatch"
    - option "Dotted"
    - option "Grid"
    - option "Striped"
  - group "Ports & Interfaces":
    - text: Ports & Interfaces
    - button "+ Add port-in"
    - button "+ Add port-out"
    - button "Add provided interface (ball)": + Provided I/F
    - button "Add required interface (socket)": + Required I/F
  - paragraph: Press Delete to remove. Press F2 to focus the name. Drag to reposition.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
